source_refs.checked_span:
Royal Enfield Himalayan
55
OPERATION OF CONTROLS
v. Compass

Center press the joystick with the compass option
selected to explore the options.

The options can be navigated by joystick up and down
press and selected by joystick center press.

Press the home button on the LH switch cube to go
back.
NOTE
Compass will function, only when there is active navigation.
GEAR UPSHIFT INDICATOR

The gear upshift indicator is a feature advising the rider
to upshift the gear for attaining better fuel efficiency &
it will respond based on Gear vs rpm vs Tps sensor sig-
nal inputs.

The upshift indicator pops up next to the gear position
indicator in the display as shown in red encircled region.

The upshift indicator will go off after shifting the gear up.
NOTE
This feature will be seen in the display only when the vehi-
cle is in dynamic condition.
